newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Innovest says in Madagascar property deal.
newsitem.headline: Innovest says in Madagascar property deal.

text.p: Malaysian construction and timber company Innovest Bhd said it has signed an in-principle agreement with the Madagascar government to build and development properties on the island.

"Innovest Bhd has signed an agreement-in-principle with the Ministry of National and Urban Territory Development in the republic of Madagascar for the construction and development of properties," it said in a statement released late on Tuesday.
The company requested the stock exchange to extend the suspension of its stock pending final details on the project.
Innovest stock was last traded on May 28 at 8.55 ringgit.
